verdict.rationale: Synctera has a first-party domestic wires guide covering Fedwire transfers between US accounts, settled in real time. The pack has no evidence of RTP or FedNow support. The real-time Internal Transfer API only moves funds between Synctera accounts, so it is an adjacent feature and does not count as an instant-payment rail. Missing for 10: RTP origination/receipt, FedNow origination/receipt, explicit wire receipt (inbound) documentation, per-rail capability comparison, independent corroboration.
